name: iós
source:
Challenge your intelligence of deduction!
Your intelligence of deduction may be the only hope to recover Arisa's lost memory!
In this interactive visual novel you participate in the drama as the leading role to advance the story.
Investigate as a detective, make deductions and use various items to solve the mystery of Arisa's amnesia. Can you reach the true ending of the story?
A beautiful heroine that exists in your computer--Arisa Yuuki. This CD-ROM is the only place where you can see her cheerful smile.
When you are tired of deduction, browse Akira Ishigaki's photo book provided in the game at your leisure. Beautiful and fun photos taken separately from "ios" will heal your fatigue.
translation:
挑战你的推理智力！
你的智慧推演或许是恢复亚里沙失去记忆的唯一希望！
在这部互动视觉小说中，你将作为主角参与戏剧，推动故事的发展。
作为一名侦探进行调查，进行推理并使用各种物品来解开亚里沙失忆之谜。你能到达故事的真正结局吗？
存在于你电脑中的美丽女主角——结城亚里沙。这张光盘是唯一能看到她灿烂笑容的地方。
当你厌倦了演绎时，闲暇时可以浏览一下游戏中提供的石垣彰写真集。与“ios”分开拍摄的美丽有趣的照片将治愈你的疲劳。
